combos.title: Cheese Steak Fries & Chicken Parm
combos.explanation: Rich, tangy fries meet crispy, saucy chicken parm. Both are indulgent but balance via acidity and crunch. Colors pop with brown, yellow, green, and red.
combos.cultural_note: Quebec comfort food often pairs rich mains with something crisp or acidic, like pickles or slaw, to cut the heaviness.
combos.tip: Share this combo to avoid overload; add a pickle on the side.
reasons: pepperoncini pepper goes with provolone cheese

sources.excerpt: Canadian and Quebec comfort food: Poutine (fries with cheese curds and gravy) is rich, salty, and soft-meets-crisp. combos.title: Chicken Parm Poutine & Fried Chicken
combos.explanation: Crispy fried chicken and saucy poutine deliver contrasting textures. Tangy and savory flavors balance the heavy weight. Green and golden hues add visual appeal.
combos.cultural_note: In Quebec, poutine is often paired with fried chicken or other crispy mains, plus a crisp side like coleslaw.
combos.tip: Order a side of coleslaw to add freshness and crunch.

combos.title: Cheesesteak & Cubano Duo
combos.explanation: Two hot, hefty sandwiches bring tender, juicy beef and ham with creamy swiss and crisp pickles. Tangy, savory richness meets soft bread and golden, brown, green color on one plate.
combos.cultural_note: Quebec comfort food loves rich, salty sandwiches with a tangy, crisp contrast. [1]
combos.tip: Serve with a cold soda or beer and extra pickles on the side.
